card.name: The bio- start of bioaccumulation
card.fires_on: The word piece "bio" right before "accumulation" or "accumulated" in environmental toxicity text about chemicals in organisms. Weaker hits fall on numbers in contaminant concentration tables.

modes.label: Bio before accumulation
modes.description: The start of "bioaccumulation" or "bioaccumulated" in text on chemicals in sediment, fish and food chains.
modes.example: Chemicals in sediments may be directly toxic to aquatic life or can be a source of chemicals for<< bio>>accumulation in the food chain.

modes.label: Numbers in contaminant tables
modes.description: Digits or symbols at the start of a concentration value for arsenic or metals in tissue data.

modes.label: Inside accumulate
modes.description: The ending of "accumulates" when describing a persistent chemical building up in the environment.
modes.example: DDT persists and accum<<ulates>> in the environment, collecting in human tissue

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward accumulation, accumulate and accumulated.
card.plain: It spots the start of the word bioaccumulation and predicts that accumulation comes next.
